message.content: Scott Sakakihara, the researched candidate for California State Senate District 10, shows a split record on the issue focus. An interview profile reports he pushed Union City in 2024 to consider a Gaza ceasefire resolution and advocated an ethical investment policy, though no final council vote is established. He also opposes delegitimizing Israel and campaigns isolating Jewish communities, while supporting dialogue, peace, and all people's safety and dignity. He supports antisemitism protections with free speech and academic freedom and is open to reviewing AB 715 and SB 48 to address concerns of supporters and opponents. CAIR Action lists him as Preferred; the Muslim Democrats and Friends Club of Alameda County endorsed him; the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club also endorsed him. Independent spending supporting Sakakihara includes META California at $1,335,520, Grow California at $1,039,940, and Uber Innovation PAC at $1,026,583; $88,273 in independent spending opposes him via a Kepner-sponsored committee.
